card.line: Chorazin was a city where Jesus did many miracles, but its people did not repent, so He warned them of judgment.

moments.title: Jesus warns Chorazin
moments.text: Jesus began to denounce the cities where most of His miracles were done, because the people did not repent. He said, "Woe to you, Chorazin!" and told them that Tyre and Sidon would have repented in sackcloth and ashes if they had seen the same miracles.

moments.title: Woe again to Chorazin
moments.text: Jesus repeated His warning to Chorazin and Bethsaida as He spoke to the seventy-two. He said it would be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for them.
